kill_mechanism: _derive_checkpoint_storage_projection and its two sibling enforcement sites (the stored-projection revalidator and the independent re-measurement) take a required single_specialist_episode parameter threaded from specialist_lineage is not None, and admit exactly two closed non-shared states: specialist_routes == [active_expert] for a lineage episode (projection unchanged, worst-case factor len(EXPERT_NAMES)) or specialist_routes == list(EXPERT_NAMES) for the full-coverage vertical (projection = optimizer_actual, factor 1). Partial multi-route state, empty optimizer state, and shared semantics stay rejected/closed. tests/ember_restart_model/test_checkpoint_artifacts.py pins all four cases (test_v5_storage_projection_admits_full_coverage_vertical_optimizer, test_v5_storage_projection_rejects_partial_multi_route_state, test_v5_storage_projection_rejects_multi_route_state_for_specialist_episode, test_v5_storage_projection_preserves_shared_semantic_checkpoint), so any regression to the single-route assumption fails in the suite before any dispatch.
mechanism: _derive_checkpoint_storage_projection (tools/ember-restart-3b/checkpoint_artifacts.py:564-581) required post-update optimizer state on exactly one specialist route (specialist_routes == [model.active_expert]) and raised ValueError: checkpoint storage projection requires one post-update optimizer state on EVERY governed-vertical run, deterministically, at the first and only checkpoint. The invariant is structurally unsatisfiable in that mode: UnifiedDecoder.forward calls _activate_expert per record (model.py:479) and the authorized vertical shard is exactly 4 records, one per expert (measured {'vision':1,'audio':1,'reasoning':1,'tool':1}), so end-of-run optimizer state covers shared plus all four specialists while model.active_expert is whatever the last record routed ('tool'). Full coverage is by design — run_pretraining_segment's require_complete_coverage demands every expert receive examples. Earlier sequential gates masked it: prior vertical runs died before reaching the projection check (train-5 at the 4 GiB scratch cap, #1305/#1306; a later train at the 12 GiB artifact-drive write budget), so this was the first 3B run to reach it and it killed the certified R1 WARM-100 dispatch. First and lowest layer of the single-active-expert invariant class, later re-derived one level up in the serialization byte bound (#1320) and again in the realization counter (#1326).
